VC.name: Value Communication
VC.question: Does your team tell a value story - or pitch features?
VC.coachCallout: Rate where your team stands today for each capability below. Be honest - the recommendations on the Results page get sharper the more accurately you score. There are no wrong answers, only useful ones.

VQ.name: Value Quantification
VQ.question: Can your team prove the value you deliver?
VQ.coachCallout: Rate where your team stands today on each capability below. Quantification is the pillar most teams find hardest - go slow, and don't be afraid to mark "Reacting" when that's the truth.

VA.name: Value Activation
VA.question: Does value-led growth live in your operating rhythm?
VA.coachCallout: Rate where your team stands today on each capability below. Activation is about whether the work sticks - training, coaching, reinforcement, and tooling. Score how the team actually operates, not how the playbook says they should.

VC: How intentionally and consistently do we define, govern, measure, and improve how value is communicated across the organization?
How effectively are people aligned, enabled, and accountable for communicating value consistently and credibly?
How effectively do we use value storytelling to attract the right buyers, shape early perceptions, and drive demand across segments and personas?
How consistently do we engage buyers with value-led conversations, interactive assets, and education that adapt to their needs, use cases, and maturity?
How effectively do we use value communication to guide executive conversations, advance deals, and understand what drives wins and losses?
How consistently do we communicate realized value to reinforce confidence, guide renewals, and drive expansion across the customer lifecycle?
How well do our tools and data enable scalable, insight-driven, and increasingly intelligent value communication across teams and buyers?
How effectively do we measure, analyze, and optimize the impact of our value communication across the buyer journey?
VQ: How clearly defined, governed, and measured is our approach to quantifying value across the customer lifecycle?
How effectively are our teams aligned, enabled, and supported to consistently quantify value using shared methods, frameworks, and practices?
How effectively do we use quantified value to attract, qualify, and prioritize the right prospects early in the buying journey?
How consistently do we uncover value drivers, assess maturity, form value hypotheses, and prioritize opportunities based on value potential?
How effectively do we quantify value to support pricing, business cases, shared value plans, and buyer decision-making during sales?
How consistently do we measure, communicate, and act on realized value to drive renewals, expansion, and long-term growth?
How well do our tools, data, and automation enable scalable, accurate, and increasingly intelligent value quantification across teams and customers?
How effectively do we measure, validate, and continuously improve the credibility, accuracy, and business impact of our value quantification efforts?
VA: How clearly defined, governed, and measured is our approach to activating value through learning, enablement, and execution across the customer lifecycle?
How effectively are our teams and leaders equipped, certified, and accountable for activating value through consistent skills, behaviors, and cross-functional collaboration?
How effectively do our teams activate value storytelling and prospecting skills to drive high-quality engagement at the top of the funnel?
How consistently do sellers and solution teams activate value skills in discovery, qualification, demos, and proof of value during active opportunities?
How effectively do our teams activate value-based selling skills in proposals, pricing, negotiation, and strategic deal execution?
How consistently do customer-facing teams activate value realization skills to reinforce outcomes, guide renewals, and drive expansion?
How well do our learning, coaching, and enablement technologies activate value skills at scale through data-driven and AI-powered reinforcement?
How effectively do we measure, reinforce, and optimize the activation of value in the field and with customers across the lifecycle?

levelBands.label: No Value Narrative
levelBands.descriptor: Value-led practices are mostly ad hoc today. Efforts depend on individual initiative rather than a defined approach, with little documentation, ownership, or measurement in place. Awareness that change is needed may be emerging, but execution is inconsistent and reactive rather than deliberate.

levelBands.label: Value by Accident
levelBands.descriptor: Your organization recognizes the need for a more deliberate approach and early efforts are underway. Foundational frameworks, roles, or tools are being introduced, but adoption is uneven and dependent on a handful of champions. Consistency and governance are still taking shape across teams.

levelBands.label: Value on Paper
levelBands.descriptor: Foundational structures are in place: frameworks, ownership, and tools have been defined and are starting to take hold. Execution is becoming more consistent, though adoption still varies by team. The building blocks exist; the focus now is embedding them as standard practice everywhere.

levelBands.label: Value in Practice
levelBands.descriptor: Defined practices are formalized and consistently applied across teams, with clear ownership and metrics in place. Execution is reliable rather than occasional. The organization is now shifting from consistent operation toward continuous refinement, using data to sharpen what already works.

levelBands.label: Value as a System
levelBands.descriptor: Value-led practices are deeply embedded and continuously refined using data and feedback. Cross-functional teams operate with shared standards and clear accountability. The remaining shift is toward a fully orchestrated, intelligence-driven system that optimizes outcomes in real time.
